description: This file defines a React component 'AddMembersButton' for managing the UI related to adding members to a channel in Mattermost, including permission gating, modal dialogs, and conditional rendering based on user limits and channel state.

classes.name: AddMembersButton
classes.description: Main React functional component for rendering the add members button with permission gating and conditional UI.

classes.name: LessThanMaxFreeUsers
classes.description: Subcomponent for rendering UI when total users are below the limit, allowing inviting users.

classes.name: MoreThanMaxFreeUsers
classes.description: Subcomponent for rendering UI when total users reach or exceed the limit, providing options to add groups or people.

methods.name: AddMembersButton
methods.description: Main component that determines whether to show invite options based on user count and permissions.

methods.name: LessThanMaxFreeUsers
methods.description: Handles rendering of invite button when user count is below limit.

methods.name: MoreThanMaxFreeUsers
methods.description: Handles rendering of add group/people button when user count exceeds limit.
